assertions.assertion: Adds or references the Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration.EntityFramework NuGet package
assertions.rationale: Uses the standard Duende.IdentityServer.EntityFramework package, not the DCR-specific Duende.IdentityServer.Configuration.EntityFramework.

assertions.assertion: Calls AddClientConfigurationStore() on the IdentityServer configuration builder
assertions.rationale: Calls AddConfigurationStore()/AddOperationalStore() on the IdentityServer builder rather than AddClientConfigurationStore() on the configuration builder.

assertions.assertion: Warns against using in-memory stores for dynamically registered clients in production
assertions.rationale: Clearly warns that in-memory stores lose dynamically registered clients on restart and are unsuitable for production.

assertions.assertion: Does NOT suggest implementing IClientConfigurationStore from scratch when the EF package is available
assertions.rationale: Relies on the EF store and never proposes hand-implementing IClientConfigurationStore.
